newsitem.title: USA: Power Control to buy Mafco unit for $291 million.
newsitem.headline: Power Control to buy Mafco unit for $291 million.

text.p: In a bid to diversify, Power Control Technologies Inc. said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy the licorice and flavoring business of Mafco Consolidated Group Inc. for a total price of $291 million.
The company said that under the agreement, it will acquire Mafco's unit -- Mafco Worldwide Corp. -- for $180 million in cash and the assumption of $111 million in debt.

A spokesman for Power Control said the acquisition was part of the company's plan to diversify and put the work some of its cash after selling its aerospace business early this year to Parker-Hannifin Corp. for about $193 million. Parker-Hannifin makes motion control components and systems for automotive and aerospace businesses.
Following the news, Mafco's stock jumped $2.375 to $27, while Power Control was off 37.5 cents at $7.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
The companies said their boards unanimously approved the deal, which is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter.
